title: 自动驾驶出租车：改变日本打车习惯，不用App坐不上？
speaker: Taroishi Nakajima

segments.en: I want to also ask you about the opportunities that robo taxis present
segments.zh: 我还想问问您，自动驾驶出租车带来了哪些机遇？

segments.en: Because I understand you have cooperation with Waymo and the Hongkou to the taxi service here in Japan as well
segments.zh: 我知道你们与Waymo以及日本的Hongkou出租车服务有合作

segments.en: What's the potential of this market and how important is it for GO?
segments.zh: 这个市场的潜力如何？对GO有多重要？

segments.en: I think robo taxis are extremely positive for Japan's taxi industry as a whole
segments.zh: 我认为自动驾驶出租车对日本出租车行业整体非常有利

segments.en: Though the number of drivers has gradually started to increase
segments.zh: 虽然司机数量已开始逐步增加

segments.en: There's still aren't enough of them
Robo taxis should be able to fill that supply gap
segments.zh: 自动驾驶出租车有望填补这一供给缺口

segments.en: So from the perspective of the overall taxi market
segments.zh: 所以从整个出租车市场的角度看

segments.en: This is a very positive development
For GO specifically it's potentially even more positive
In Japan today you don't have to use an app to get a taxi
segments.zh: 如今在日本，叫出租车不一定要用App

segments.en: You can hail one on the street
Get one at a station or call one by phone
segments.zh: 在车站打车或电话叫车

segments.en: But with autonomous vehicles you would essentially have to call them through an app
segments.zh: 但自动驾驶汽车基本上需要通过App来叫车

segments.en: That means autonomous taxis would have extremely high app penetration
segments.zh: 这意味着自动驾驶出租车的App渗透率会非常高

segments.en: So the more autonomous driving is introduced
segments.zh: 因此，自动驾驶引入得越多

segments.en: The higher the app penetration rate of Japan's taxi market will become
segments.zh: 日本出租车市场的App渗透率就会越高
